passages.note: Bill details page lists Rep. Matthew Lehman as a co-author of HJR 3 (2014).
passages.actor_quote: Co-Authored by: Rep. Timothy Wesco, Rep. Wes Culver, Rep. Rhonda Rhoads, Rep. Robert Heaton, Rep. Don Lehe, Rep. Matthew Lehman, Rep. Randall Frye.

passages.provision_quote: Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana.
passages.note: Prints the sole operative provision of HJR 3, which Lehman co-authored.
House Roll Call 70 shows Lehman voting Yea on HJR 3's third reading.

rows.reasoning: Lehman co-authored HJR 3 (2014) and voted Yea on its House third reading (Roll Call 70); the resolution's sole operative text states 'Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana,' matching the rung to make same-sex marriage illegal and define marriage as only between one man and one woman.
